cases.requirement: Exact commit and crate versions build on the declared toolchain.
Required analysis/session/configuration/workspace/file/index/diagnostic/semantic APIs are public.
No private module access, permanent fork, or dynamic plugin ABI is required.
License, feature set, Rust edition, MSRV/toolchain, and relevant dependency identity are recorded.
Analyzer configuration is supplied explicitly through owned data.
No user, workspace, or editor configuration is read or mutated for correctness.
Main and Library workspaces remain distinguishable.
All closed fixture files can be added deterministically.
File update and removal change analyzer state and published facts correctly.
Public file/source identity does not expose temporary or absolute host paths.
Duplicate or conflicting file registrations are rejected or explicitly classified.
The closed C_E0Fixture declaration file loads as Library content.
KnownApi and SecretText resolve from Main files through the Library workspace.
Library declarations are not emitted as first-party project findings.
A broken Library fixture produces an explicit root capability failure and invalidates dependent resolution.
The dedicated generic-error fixture produces one stable built-in semantic category through the public API.
The clean counterpart does not produce the selected category under complete diagnostics coverage.
Upstream code, upstream severity, normalized severity, source span, and structured arguments can be recorded.
Rendered message text is not required as diagnostic identity.
Every additional diagnostic family emitted by the fixture set is inventoried and classified.
KnownApi yields exact resolved global/member/call facts.
RemovedApi yields unresolved member/call observations without a platform-absence conclusion.
Receiver, member-name, full-reference, callee, argument, and call spans are obtainable or exact required subsets are documented.
SecretText producer call and local initializer binding are identifiable.
The selected direct local concatenation operation is identifiable for the exact binding.
canaccessvalue call arguments and the guarded binding can be identified structurally.
Dominance or an equivalent exact control-flow relation can distinguish guarded, after-use, and different-value cases.
No emitted fact contains a Secret or safety verdict.
ASCII LF ranges convert exactly to UTF-8 byte half-open spans.
CRLF ranges convert against exact supplied bytes.
Multibyte UTF-8, emoji, and combining sequences preserve exact byte and derived UTF-16 positions.
Empty-file and EOF spans have explicit tested semantics.
Spans are recomputed after updates and stale spans are rejected.
Changing one Main file updates its diagnostics and facts.
Removing a file removes all current facts and findings for that file.
Changing the Library invalidates dependent reference facts.
Unchanged outputs are reused only when their currency is proven.
Different update orders leading to identical final content produce identical canonical output.
File discovery order does not alter canonical snapshots, facts, or diagnostics.
Temporary root path does not alter public handles or canonical identity.
Worker scheduling and upstream diagnostic return order do not alter canonical output.
Record fixture file count, bytes, cold session/index latency, update latency, fact/diagnostic counts, and memory when practical.
Run a bounded synthetic library expansion to detect pathological scaling without loading full Blizzard source.
One malformed Main file produces no fabricated semantic facts.
A broken Library blocks dependent resolution but preserves explicitly independent capabilities.
Simulated upstream panic/session corruption publishes no new partial snapshot.
Budget/cancellation failure has typed state and cannot appear as clean output.
